newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Algerian president holds talks in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: Algerian president holds talks in Bahrain.

text.p: Algerian President Liamine Zeroual held talks on Gulf and Arab developments and bilateral relations with Bahrain's Emir Sheikh Isa bin Sulman al-Khalifa, the Gulf News Agency reported.

It said late on Tuesday the meeting was attended by Prime Minister Sheikh Khalifa bin Sulman al-Khalifa and senior ruling family members, shortly after Zeroual arrived on the first visit by an Algerian leader to Bahrain.
Zeroual was due in Beijing on Thursday for a five-day visit to China, then will go on to Vietnam and visit Qatar on his way back to Algeria.
